# Receiver Crosswind v0.13.0

Windbreak selectors use the existing contextual X/E action; no new gameplay menu or binding is introduced. Tracked-controller interaction reaches the same selector logic. Choosing a protected angle does not bypass projectile collision, including when a tracked gun origin would reach through the active screen. Existing fixed menu controls, remaps, tracked-hand spatial UI, head independence and legal diorama openings are retained. Hands remain UI-only. Physical acceptance remains open.

# Receiver Crosswind v0.13.0

The Bellwether rooftop now offers switchable windbreak cover and a recoverable gallery retreat. Existing district geometry, systems, save namespaces, controls, first-person VR and diorama VR/AR are retained. Read RECEIVER-CROSSWIND.md and DEVELOPMENT-HANDOFF.md; verify publication using the versioned release receipt. The prior section below documents the v0.12 foundation, not a pending implementation task.

# Aether Reach: current level-design reconciliation

Reviewed base: master 78dad9840163bbacb7308118cde44a1bb4f525f6, with released 0.12.0 Bellwether Rewired. Use the game's own release receipt, handoff and roadmap as current authority. Read the five uppercase library entry/manual/recommendation/review/reference files before applying this brief. Some lowercase/index paths mentioned by the original library README were not present in that edition; do not infer unseen content from their names.

Already implemented before this iteration: safe repeatable induction bench, marked conductive surfaces, circuit gauges, repair-opened west shutter, continuous maintenance galleries, visible restored lamps/warning wheel, skinned courier, first-person VR and three legal third-person diorama openings in VR/AR. These are not new tasks to rebuild.

V02 / Receiver Crosswind refines V01 and P01: one switchable rooftop windbreak changes actual firing lanes and cover; the existing east gallery becomes a non-resetting combat recovery. The same screens block movement, AI sight and both sides' shots. Basic equipment must remain sufficient. No extra map area, enemies or reward are introduced. See ../../aether-reach/RECEIVER-CROSSWIND.md and tests/windbreak.test.mjs, plus BELL_WIND=1 tests/bellwether-browser.py.

Hypothesis: manipulating district infrastructure and reusing the ascent for recovery creates more intentional combat decisions than a flat rooftop endurance fight. Model tests are not fresh-player evidence. Final runtime/native/publication/archive status belongs in ../../release-receipts/aether-v0.13.0-20260915.json. Physical Xbox/Quest and unfamiliar-player acceptance remain open regardless of software success.

Next observation: can a player identify which lane a screen exposes, reposition rather than fire into cover, and retreat/re-enter without expecting a reset? Next authoring opportunity is arrival comprehension and rail decision visibility, not city expansion. Preserve the game-specific controls, legacy saves, licenses, private story boundary and independent sibling projects.
